en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father and Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari both narrated to me from ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari, from ‘Ali ibn Ismā’īl Al-Qummi, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Amr Al-Zayyāt, from Qā`id Al-Ḥannāť, who said: Abul Ḥasan Al-Māďi (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) said:
Allāh will forgive all of the past and future sins of those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) knowing his rights.
